mutants.command:
git diff "$FLOT_PROOFS_FROM" -- src > "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff"
if [ -s "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff" ]; then
  cargo mutants --in-diff "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff" --exclude-re "tests::" -j 4 --timeout 300 -o "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR"
else
  # No code changed: a report of no mutants.
  mkdir "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/mutants.out"
  echo '{"schemaVersion": "1", "thresholds": {"high": 80, "low": 60}, "files": {}}' > "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/mutants.out/outcomes.json"
fi
